C1.golden_fixture: the node's CHECKS.json (read by cargo a_): status pass_scoped, inputs.oracle_sha256 == sha256(oracle), parity_fixture (incl. sha256_outputs) == the fresh run's

hex_bitwise: state RHS (no absorber, the runner's absorber, explicit group rates)
partial_t (vs the oracle's grid_state_partial_t with the runner's dkbar)
jvp callback output (the adapter evaluates J s through its RHS) == oracle state RHS of s
band == dense inside the band, dense == 0 outside
C2.jacobian_action: J_dense s (numpy, the runner's dense J) vs the oracle state RHS of s: |d|_k <= 1e-14 (|J| |s|)_k (exact where (|J||s|)_k = 0)
C2.kbar_vs_p02_reference: per group vs lrs_reference.kbar_closed with the sphere's float threshold (x = q_chi + ((ln a1 + ln a2) + ln a3)/3, rate = mean H): |d| <= 1e-14 |ref| for k and dk, exact where ref = 0, bitwise at exact ties
C2.kbar_mpmath_H: per group vs lrs_reference.kbar_mpmath (40 digits; reported only)
C2.kbar_vs_lrs_adapter: cross-check: physical coordinate bitwise; comoving |dk| <= 1e-12 max_i |k_lrs|, |d dk| <= 1e-12 max_i |dk_lrs| (the P02 adapter rounds the mean ln a differently)
C2.note: every value compared by its hex (bitwise, the sign of zero included); every case must run OK

C3.def: max over outputs and energy groups i of max(max_j |sum_k N_ijk - N_ij|, |A_i,3D - A_i,2D|) / max(max_j |N_ij|, |A_i,2D|), and |L_3D - L_2D| / |L_2D| for the outflow ledgers (exact where L_2D = 0); phi-summed 3D adapter vs the P02 adapter, both fixed_banded with the same steps
C3.axisymmetry_def: max over outputs and groups i of max_j (max_k N_ijk/g_k - min_k N_ijk/g_k) / max_j |N_ij|
C3.adaptive_H: the same comparison for adaptive banded runs at rtol 1e-8 (reported only)

C4.def: max over outputs and groups i of (max_jk u_i - min_jk u_i) / max_jk u_i, u_ijk = N_ijk / (dmu_j dphi_k), isotropic geometry and data

C5.time_uncertainty: sum |N(rtol 1e-7) - N(rtol 1e-9)| / sum |N_exact| <= 0.02 err at every level
C5.quadrature_uncertainty: at the coarsest level: |err(GL 3) - err(GL 5)| <= 0.25 err, and sum |N_exact,GL3 - N_exact,GL5| / sum |N_exact,GL5| <= 0.02 err at t = 0 and at T
C5.def: sum |N_rust(T) - N_exact(T)| / sum |N_exact(T)| over cells, N_exact the tensor Gauss-Legendre cell integrals of the exact characteristic solution (oracle exact_cell_contents)

C7.def: states and WorkCounters equal across two runs
C7.trajectory_invariant_def: |fsum(y(t)) - fsum(y(0))| / |fsum(y(0))| (every slot: cells, absorbed and outflow ledgers) at every output of every C3 (3D and 2D, both arms), C4, C6 and C7 trajectory (the P02 C3 / P04 C3 bound)

C8.code: the oracle's refusal code for the same input where it has one, else the listed literal
